login_huggingface_token: login to huggingface hub using a token and optionally save to git credential helper
logout_huggingface_token: logout from a specific huggingface hub access token by name
switch_huggingface_token: switch between stored huggingface hub access tokens interactively or by name
list_huggingface_tokens: list all stored huggingface hub access tokens
whoami_huggingface_account: find out which huggingface hub account you are currently logged in as
